timelineList:
lock_clock
Most urgent · 2–3 years to explosion
Post-Quantum Cryptography (PQC)
Enterprises must complete a full cryptographic upgrade before quantum computers break RSA/ECC. The pain point is the massive migration effort of replacing every existing asymmetric-crypto system.
2029 Google global deadline
precision_manufacturing
Now – 5 years
Manufacturing AI
Full-chain digitalization from design to production to O&M, with edge compute deployment. As a global manufacturing hub, Taiwan is the best testbed for physical AI.
Taiwan = Physical AI testbed
account_balance
3 – 5 years
On-Chain Banking
Real-world asset (RWA) tokenization, decentralized settlement, and cross-border payment infrastructure are reshaping traditional banking's back-office and settlement layer.
RWA tokenization accelerating
shield
5 – 10 years
Defense Tech
Dual-use autonomous systems, advanced sensing, defense-grade LLMs, and protective materials — a long-cycle, high-barrier but deeply moated category.
Long cycle, high barrier

opinionGrid:
PQC migration tooling & crypto-agility for enterprises
2029 is a hard forcing function — expect a wave of startups helping enterprises inventory and migrate their cryptographic systems.
Edge AI agents for manufacturing O&M
As Taiwan becomes the physical-AI testbed, the next wave is edge autonomous agents on the O&M side — not just design/production.
RWA settlement & cross-border stablecoin payment rails
The next step in on-chain finance isn't tokenization itself — it's the settlement layer and cross-border payment-rail infrastructure.
Dual-use sensing & autonomous maritime / LEO systems
Hyarks and Phasetrum show dual-use sensing + autonomous systems is a long-cycle but deeply moated direction.
Defensible data-moat vertical AI (vs. crowded horizontal SaaS)
Against the crowdedness of OmniEase/CloudStation, Decisions Lab proves vertical, data-dense AI is far more defensible.
AI-chip thermal/power materials
Ruomei and Phasetrum hint at a materials-science × AI-hardware crossover that will keep growing with AI compute demand.
